item.text:
You can see this in Mistral’s **Model Selection Guide**, which compares each model’s capabilities, including function calling, structured outputs, OCR, embeddings, transcription, and more:

[Compare Mistral model capabilities](https://docs.mistral.ai/getting-started/models/compare)

You can also inspect the capabilities returned for a specific API model using the [Models API endpoint](https://docs.mistral.ai/api/endpoint/models).
